fusions.name: Bent Light
fusions.desc: Bends a bolt of arcane light into the first enemy it meets, dealing 11 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Siphoning Mote
fusions.desc: Fires a mote of raw arcana through a coral lens at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It has a 30% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Quickened Growth
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 30% for 12 seconds, and restores 8 health at once.

fusions.name: Full Reservoir
fusions.desc: While you are at full mana, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
